correctness.rationale: Headline has two parts: (A) F-independent degree obstruction: for socle-4 quartic F with HF (1,3,5,3,1), MW second higher Hessian determinant H2(F) has degree (4-4)*5=0, hence constant with no factor pattern, making target's universal (H1,H2)-factor-implies-block lemma unsatisfiable; (B) certified witness F0=X^4+X^3Y+Y^3Z+Z^4 with HF (1,3,5,3,1), H1 sextic 1+5 split, H2=15116544. (A) verified from MW Def 3.1/Thm 3.1 (fetched full text arXiv:0903.3581v3): Hess^{(d)} = det(alpha_i^{(d)} alpha_j^{(d)} F), each entry homogeneous of degree D-2d, so det has degree (D-2d) dim A_d; for D=4,d=2 gives 0. Cell definition gives dim A_2=5, so H2 is scalar for every F (nonzero iff A_2 pairing nondegenerate, as Gorenstein duality guarantees). Scalar has no irreducible degrees/multiplicities/incidence; target second clause vacuous uniformly. Indexing matches admitted target/audit plan (first and second higher Hessian determinants H1,H2; 5x5 determinant), and DRAFT explicitly limits refutation to MW-indexed claim, avoiding rename escape. (B) independently re-ran inputs/artifacts/replay.py -> VERIFY_OK hf [1,3,5,3,1] H1-degs [1,5] Hess2 15116544; reimplemented catalecticants from scratch: ranks 1,3,5,3,1 (shapes (1,15),(3,10),(6,6),(10,3),(15,1)), C2 rank 5 pivots [0,1,2,4,5], Gram det 15116544; Ann_2 left nullspace 1-dim spanned by XZ operator = xz in Q-notation, confirming Ann(F0)_2=span{xz}; H1 equality and factor_list (-1/2,[(a,1),(quintic,1)]) degree 6 confirmed; L=X^3Y+Y^4+Z^4+X^2Z^2 and M=X^4+Y^4+Z^4+X^2Y^2+Y^2Z^2 rechecked HF (1,3,5,3,1) and Gram dets 107495424/681836544 as claimed; Jordan partitions for (1,1,1),(1,0,0),(0,1,0),(0,0,1),(0,1,1),(1,-1,1) rechecked via independent kernel dims (e.g. (1,1,1) kd [5,8,11,12,13,13]->[5,3,3,1,1]; (0,1,0) kd [5,9,11,13,13,13]->[4,4,2,2,1]) all summing to 13. Proof vs certificate distinguished: impossibility is F-independent proof, not failed search; witness/Jordan tables are exact-QQ certificates; 289-point scan honestly left open, no overclaim.
